page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A defining characteristic of this server is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

From a performance and architectural standpoint, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high-density storage profile. The use of traditional HDD storage instead of SSDs indicates a design optimized for sequential read and write operations and massive capacity rather than high random IOPS. This represents a clear tradeoff: users gain access to nearly 94 TB of local storage at a highly competitive qualitative cost-per-gigabyte, but sacrifice the low latency and high random access speeds associated with solid-state drives. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants.

This hardware profile is specifically suited for workloads that require massive local storage capacity and high sequential throughput. Appropriate use cases include large-scale data warehousing, log collection and analysis, big data processing frameworks, and cold or warm data archiving. It is also suitable for distributed file systems and large database backups where storage volume is the primary constraint.
